changes.summary: Lens: DynamicChildren no longer loops level queries and resolves in nested root levels; quarter period presets; table levels in explorers (WithView(KindTable), Level.table); serve.Config.DocumentOptions, automatic period filter and RangeParam binding for date_range variables; theme="auto" for LensDashboard (and drawers restored from the address take the board theme); 12-colour category palette (color.Categories, Positive/Negative) and literal row colours without ColorByCategory.
